cavyzap.description: Cavyzap has always been extremely insecure and is never seen outside the cage. But don't be mistaken—the cage isn't a prison but a safehouse. As long as the house is there, Cavyzap isn't afraid to give passing Zobos the stink eye.

requirements.text: Defeat 300 Zobos while clearing stages.

skill.name: Kinesis Cage
skill.description: Shoots an Electricage orb that deals small AoE damage and creates an Electricage. Fires piercing signals towards the Electricage after, creating an electric surge that deals small AoE damage after impact.

hippiehog.name: Hippiehog
hippiehog.description: The cage has been upgraded to a cozy home. Although usually only brave enough to peek through the door, Hippiehog will angrily (but quietly) let potential intruders know that they are not welcome.

requirements.text: Feed Hippiehog to increase stats 3 times.
Use 2,000 skateboards or 2,000 fishing rods.

skill.name: Magnetic Cage
skill.description: Shoots an Electricage orb that deals small AoE damage and creates an Electricage. Fires piercing signals towards the Electricage after, creating an electric surge that deals AoE damage after impact.

wheekroller.name: Wheekroller
wheekroller.description: Wheekroller is no longer a homebody and has fallen in love with running. The windmill keeps on spinning ahead and it feels like flying! For some reason the scenery hasn't changed, but as far as Wheekroller is concerned it's the top of the world.

requirements.text: Feed this Tatari to B quality.
Use 6,000 skateboards or 6,000 fishing rods.
Obtain 50 more Tatari Wishboxes.

skill.name: Tataraday Cage
skill.description: Shoots an Electricage orb that deals small AoE damage and creates an Electricage. Fires piercing signals towards the Electricage after, creating an electric surge that deals AoE damage upon impact. Gigagnash carries Aura: Lightning whenever on the field.

gigagnash.name: Gigagnash
gigagnash.description: The ultimate solution to feeling insecure is to become the strongest being in existence. Giganash has done exactly so, piloting a nice sturdy mech to bravely crush Zobos in the way. The world isn't so scary after all.

skill.name: Fish Ahoy
skill.description: Throws 3 fish in turn to deal AoE damage. Carries Foodie: Fragile. When in Danger, eats 1 fish to recover HP and dispel all other debuffs.

snowcub.name: Snowcub
snowcub.description: Snowcub has a great appetite but not so great hunting skills. After finally catching one fish, Snowcub now brings it everywhere as a bluff to cover the fact that there's no catching another one any time soon.

requirements.text: Feed Snowcub any 30 food items.

skill.name: Fish Delish
skill.description: Throws 4 fish in turn to deal AoE damage. Carries Foodie: Fragile. When in Danger, eats 1 fish to recover HP and dispel all other debuffs.

polarpaw.name: Polarpaw
polarpaw.description: Polarpaw is gradually learning to discern the distinct smell of fish, the flow of currents, and movement patterns beneath the ice. Although sometimes the prey turns out to be seaweed, random sticks of wood, and even Polarpaw's own shadow, this is all part of the master plan. At least, that's what Polarpaw would tell you.

requirements.text: Feed Polarpaw to increase stats 3 times.
Use 2,000 fishing rods or 200,000 Gold Hunt Coins.

skill.name: Fish Feast
skill.description: Throws 4 fish in turn to deal AoE damage. Carries Foodie: Fragile. When in Danger, shares 1 fish with an ally to recover HP and dispel all other debuffs.

requirements.text: Feed this Tatari to B quality.
Use 6,000 fishing rods or 600,000 Gold Hunt Coins.
Feed Blizzgrizz 15 Wavebreaker Sushi Boats.

skill.name: Fish Bonanza
skill.description: Throws 4 fish in turn to deal AoE damage. Carries Foodie: Fragile. When in Danger, shares 1 fish with an ally to recover HP and dispel all other debuffs. Anglerbear carries Aura: Water whenever on the field.

skill.name: Bushy Debut
skill.description: Orders Lackeys to continuously deal AoE damage. After Lackeys return, provides healing and Vigilante: ATK Boost to allies within a small area.

ringtail.name: Ringtail
ringtail.description: Ringtail is an expert at finding things without owners somehow. Cookies left on the bakery counter, fresh fruit from the market... and since everything's shared among four, Ringtail always makes a point to grab a couple extra.

requirements.text: Obtain Cookies, Rock Candy Rings, Crystal Stone Tacos, or Rock Cakes, 50 total.

skill.name: Sleight of Hand
skill.description: Orders Lackeys to continuously deal AoE damage. After Lackeys return, provides healing and Vigilante: ATK Boost to allies within the area.

rizzler.name: Rizzler
rizzler.description: Rizzler figured wearing a mask keeps you safe from being recognized, but that charming smirk and familiar figure already left their mark in the hearts of many.

requirements.text: Participate in Camp Treasure Hunt by digging up 40 treasure-containing plots, or use 2,400 Fertilizers on the Magic Farm.

skill.name: Myriad Masks
skill.description: Orders Lackeys to continuously deal large AoE damage. After Lackeys return, provides healing and Vigilante: ATK Boost to allies within the area.

zorrock.name: Zorrock
zorrock.description: Zorrock is no lowly thief, but a con artist who plans out the perfect style, timing, and escape route. The moment people notice something's gone missing—that's when Zorrock makes a dramatic entrance up high, leaving onlookers stunned before disappearing without a trace.

requirements.text: Participate in the Camp Treasure Hunt by digging up 120 treasure-containing plots, or use 7,200 Fertilizers on the Magic Farm.

skill.name: The Final Act
skill.description: Orders Lackeys to continuously deal large AoE damage. After Lackeys return, provides healing and Vigilante: ATK Boost to allies within the area. Phantothief carries Aura: Rock whenever on the field.

phantothief.name: Phantothief
phantothief.description: If you want to take on Phantothief, keep a tight watch on the cookies, keys, and other pretty trinkets in your pocket. Between the seductive smiles and gestures, however, this handsome thief just might snatch something even more precious. Someone's heart, perhaps?

skill.name: Tidal Tunes
skill.description: Launches sound waves that provide healing and grant stackable Joysong: DMG Boost to allies in their path

dolphie.name: Dolphie
dolphie.description: Dolphie loves chasing clouds on sunny days, skimming across the sea as the world brightens under sunlight. The sky's a perfect shade of blue today, and Dolphie's mood couldn't be better.

requirements.text: Purchase 5 of any building.

skill.name: Flowing Melodies
skill.description: Launches sound waves and sometimes launches larger surging waves. Allies in contact will recieve healing and stackable Joysong: DMG Boost & DMG Reduction.

blubbles.name: Blubbles
blubbles.description: Each time Blubbles returns to the bay, small wooden planks carrying flowers and seashells float across the water. The petals scatter and drift as Blubbles swims through, leaving the harbor a little liveleier than before.

requirements.text: Increase attributes 3 times by feeding;
Consume 2,000 Fishing Rods or 200,000 Gold Hunter Coins.

skill.name: Sweet Symphony
skill.description: Launches sound waves and often launches larger surging waves. Allies in contact will recieve healing and stackable Joysong: DMG Boost & DMG Reduction.

aquariel.name: Aquariel
aquariel.description: When Aquariel leaps out of water, the vibrant colors of rainbows would follow, skipping across the waves and into the distance. For those who are lucky enough to witness it, it is believed that good fortune will soon arrive on the sea breeze.

requirements.text: Reach Grade B by feeding;
Consume 6,000 Fishing Rods or 600,000 Gold Hunter Coins;
Initiate or participate in 20 all-out attacks in Gold Rush;

skill.name: Endless Echo
skill.description: Launches sound waves and often launches larger surging waves. Allies in contact will recieve healing and stackable Joysong: DMG Boost & DMG Reduction. Irisia carries Aura: Water whenever on field.

irisia.name: Irisia
irisia.description: As light pours down from the sky, Irisia returns from the depths of the thunderstorm, parting massive waves to clear a safe path. As long as Irisia still roams these seas, the lights of every home along the shore will stay on, steady and bright.
